subject: Sains
semantics_source: Original KPM Year 2 DSKP extracted text, pp46-47 and p61 (document printed pagination).

missing_content_sp.official_dskp_text: Memerihalkan bahawa anak mewarisi ciri daripada ibu, bapa atau keturunan.
missing_content_sp.pbd_scope: Explain that some characteristics may be inherited; use only fictional example family cards; do not infer parenthood from appearances.
missing_content_sp.pedagogical_privacy_adaptation: Buku memaparkan gambar hubungan keluarga rekaan. Jangan guna ciri fizikal untuk meneka hubungan kandung sebenar murid.

missing_content_sp.official_dskp_text: Memberi contoh ciri yang diwarisi oleh anak daripada ibu bapa atau keturunan seperti warna kulit, warna mata dan jenis rambut.
missing_content_sp.pbd_scope: Use age-appropriate imaginary family examples; avoid judging pupils' appearance or ancestry.
missing_content_sp.pedagogical_privacy_adaptation: Buku menyebut warna kulit/iris dan jenis rambut; tidak perlu mengelaskan atau membanding rupa murid sebenar.

missing_content_sp.official_dskp_text: Menjelaskan pemerhatian tentang tumbesaran dan pewarisan melalui lakaran, TMK, penulisan atau lisan.
missing_content_sp.pbd_scope: Two independent pieces of evidence: fictional growth measurement vs candidate inherited characteristics; student individual oral/written account.
missing_content_sp.pedagogical_privacy_adaptation: Halaman buku meminta ciri keluarga sendiri; alternatif berasaskan kad keluarga rekaan disediakan untuk melindungi privasi.

source_conflicts.printed_dskp_text: Mengitlak tumbesaran adalah berbeza antara individu dengan menjalankan aktiviti.
source_conflicts.observed_legacy_mismatch: The source title previously describes inheritance, which is 3.1.4-3.1.6, not 3.1.3.
source_conflicts.action: Keep source PdP003 ID, use growth-only draft title and flag legacy title for review.

source_conflicts.printed_dskp_text: Menjelaskan pemerhatian tentang campuran melalui lakaran, TMK, penulisan atau lisan.

source_conflicts.action: Keep word campuran as exact official wording; Year2 PdP051 construction activity remains DRAF/HOLD and requires academic source decision.
